- Committed boundary cleanup and Ralph progress as 7b5672f (`refactor: remove api router startup wrapper`) and pushed to origin/master.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully enough to update current_tasks/current_tasks_done and send the completion email; script also printed `rm: cannot remove .../.ralph/current_task.txt: No such file or directory`, which matches an already-tracked Ralph bug.
- If resuming later: start from the next Ralph task; the code change itself is complete and validated.

- Read prior codex progress; previous startup wrapper cleanup was already complete and pushed.
- Loaded improve-code-boundaries skill and listed src/tests files for candidate work.
- Next: inspect found_smells first, then choose one concrete boundary cleanup and implement it.

- Identified one boundary smell in startup wiring: pginfo/dcs/process each wrap a runtime context in a one-method worker newtype.
- Verified call sites are local to startup modules and runtime/node.rs; api/ha already use direct ctx execution.
- Next: remove the wrapper newtypes, add direct startup::run(ctx) entrypoints, then validate with lint/test.

- Removed startup-only worker wrapper newtypes from pginfo/dcs/process and rewired runtime/node to call startup::run(ctx) directly.
- Patch is limited to startup wiring and reduces the fake boundary without adding replacement types.
- Next: finish make lint, then run make test, then commit/push/task switch.

- make lint failed on a real private-interface issue: DcsRuntimeCtx stayed module-private while startup started exposing it.
- Chose the smaller flattening fix: align DcsRuntimeCtx visibility to pub(crate), matching PgInfoWorkerCtx and ProcessWorkerCtx rather than restoring another wrapper.
- Next: rerun make lint, then run make test if clean.

- make lint now passes after aligning DcsRuntimeCtx visibility with the other runtime context types.
- Started make test; this uses cargo nextest per repo policy and is the required full test target for the task.
- Next: let tests finish, then inspect git state, commit including .ralph files, push, and run task_switch.

- make test passed after make lint; no test-long run was performed.
- Staged src changes plus .ralph bookkeeping and started git commit with message: refactor: remove startup worker wrappers.
- Next: wait for the post-commit hook/docs publish to finish, then push and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
